fields.label: Project Description
fields.value:
BondTrace helps a bond issuer service a tokenized test instrument from placement to final retirement. The console shows who is entitled, the exact amount owed, the action to sign and its settlement receipt.

An issuer creates fixed terms, registers holders, places bonds and reserves all principal and coupon obligations before activation. At each record date, the Solana program fixes coupon rights. Later transfers do not move those earlier rights. Investors claim test settlement tokens, receive principal at maturity while the corresponding bonds burn atomically, and cast informational votes using a proposal snapshot.

Solana makes the entitlement and execution state independently inspectable. An Anchor program enforces the corporate-action rules, and classic SPL Token performs settlement and retirement. The backend reads the required financial accounts in one confirmed context, reconciles exact integer totals and keeps durable recovery IDs. If a response is lost, the same signed operation is checked instead of preparing another payment.

A verified localnet issuer cycle placed fifteen bonds, paid two coupons totaling 1,125 test units and 15,000 principal units, burned all fifteen bonds and left zero in the reserve. Its unsigned preparation survived an API restart. This evidence uses generated test signers; it is not a human-wallet test. A separate 2:54 product video shows an earlier real browser-driven eighteen-bond cycle.

The prototype supports up to sixteen registered wallets and eight fixed coupons. It is not connected to a bank, KASE or a custodian, and represents no real security. Devnet deployment, human-wallet verification, judge-accessible URLs and official World's Fair registration/submission are not yet confirmed. No customers, partnerships or validated demand are claimed. Next work is external-wallet/devnet verification and an issuer-led pilot after the required legal and operational integrations.

fields.label: Anything Else
fields.value:
The short current technical overview is docs/release/JUDGE-TECHNICAL-OVERVIEW.md. README contains pinned versions and reproduction commands; docs/22-BACKEND-READINESS.md maps each verification result to its evidence. Source, program ID and recorded signatures refer to localnet. A local Explorer URL requires that validator and is not a publicly verifiable devnet receipt. The existing video and newer backend evidence use different test issues, identified separately.

Implemented: test issue administration, registered holders, immutable record-date rights, exact coupon payments, atomic principal payment and bond retirement, informational snapshot voting, financial reconciliation and durable same-operation recovery. Simulated or absent: real securities, fiat/bank/KASE/custody integration, regulatory onboarding and institutional settlement. Full prefunding is required; excess reserve has no withdrawal path. The prototype uses confirmed commitment and has not had a production security audit.

Development used AI assistance and installed ProofPilot/Solana/design guidance with Anchor, Solana Kit, React and classic SPL Token. No completed competitor product was imported. Generated test accounts are not users or traction. Public asset links and main hackathon entry must be verified before submission.
